title: Critical and Cultural Theories
overview: Critical theories offer different questions about how texts and cultural practices make meaning. Move from form and signs to readers, then power and identity, and finally the instability and social life of meaning. Use each approach as a justified interpretive lens.

Test fixed meanings and identities through texts and cultural practices.
